verdict.rationale: TruffleHog provides concrete confidence-based filtering via --only-verified and --results=verified,unknown flags plus a --fail flag for CI gating, and per-detector verification overrides (--verify-detectors/--no-verify-detectors), directly enabling teams to suppress unverified/low-confidence noise from blocking builds. Missing for 10: explicit severity-tiering (only verified/unverified/unknown confidence exists, not a graded severity scale) and independent/hands-on corroboration of gating behavior in real CI pipelines.
